agy.note: agy does not use cwd as its workspace: --add-dir {project} is required, and with several --add-dir dirs it may resolve RELATIVE paths against the media dir — prompts must use absolute {{WORKSPACE}} paths (the bundled phase prompts do). Outer timeout must stay above --print-timeout (15m).

claude.note: Write added 2026-10-02 (owner decision): with the original Read,Edit,Bash claude refused to create new files headless, which phase 02 needs (implementation_notes.md, new source files).

codex.note: npm .cmd shim — unwrapped to node + codex.js so the multi-line prompt is not cut by cmd.exe. --skip-git-repo-check lets it run in non-git project dirs.

kimi.note: Do NOT add --auto: kimi rejects '--prompt' combined with '--auto'. -p alone runs to completion.

gemini.note: --skip-trust is required headless, otherwise exit 55 (untrusted directory).

copilot.note: copilot.bat -> powershell copilot.ps1; a multi-line argument would be cut, so the prompt goes through a file. Its .ps1 loads the PowerShell profile; an 'fnm not recognized' error in stderr is harmless.
